text: The Laird in Focus Planning Study seeks to establish a planning framework to manage growth and development along Laird Drive and Eglinton Avenue East within the Leaside neighbourhood. This study responds to the $8 billion investment in the Eglinton Crosstown Light Rail Transit (LRT) project, and will put in place a planning framework to accommodate prescribed population and job growth around the LRT station, address transportation and servicing capacity issues and create a plan for a complete, mixed use and vibrant community. In 2016, the City of Toronto launched Laird in Focus – a multi-disciplinary study that would build off the Eglinton Connects Planning Study of 2014 and examine the potential to accommodate future residential, mixed use and/or employment growth at Laird Drive and Eglinton Avenue East, the location of a future station for the LRT.
